videos.title: 🟨 COMPLETE GUIDE to the GOETY MOD | MAGIC/RITUALS/ NEW STRUCTURES AND BOSSES in MINECRAFT
Goety - The Dark Arts (1.20.1) | Full Showcase

order: The book is genuinely step one. Guide: 'This item, when opened, gives us access to the first steps. Basically the first thing we'll discover is the dark arts.' -> goety:black_book. It is the mod's own progression UI and names its sections ('first steps', then 'magic', then 'rituals').

goety:cursed_infuser is the true first machine and the jar makes this unarguable: it is the ONLY source of the mod's four base materials. Recipe is lapis + cauldron + stone bricks + coal block, so it is reachable on day one.
Infuse the four basics: stone -> goety:shade_stone, iron -> goety:cursed_ingot, amethyst -> goety:empty_focus, emerald -> goety:magic_emerald. Everything downstream is built from these.
goety:magic_fabric (2 string + lapis + gold ingot) is the other early craft, and it plus goety:empty_focus is what makes the wand.
goety:dark_wand is the first real tool - 2 lapis + goety:empty_focus + goety:magic_fabric + planks. Guide: 'now you know how to craft a wand and how to make focus items'.

Then the altar, which is what unlocks the rest of the mod: goety:dark_altar = 2x goety:magic_emerald + shade stone + a pedestal. Guide heard it as 'awakened emeralds'; the jar says goety:magic_emerald.

Surround it with pedestals - goety:pedestal (and its stone/deepslate/blackstone/marble/end_stone/nether_brick/prismarine variants). Guide: 'once we've gathered enough Shade Stone and built a Dark Altar, typically I've seen at most 8 pedestals used, so that number should be plenty.'
Now rituals, which is where the mod actually lives. Start with a trivial summon to learn the loop - the guide picks the black wolf ritual, 'super simple: a dark altar and two bones'.
goety:soul_emerald (8x goety:magic_emerald around an goety:empty_focus) is the mid-game currency item that activates the higher necroturgy rituals such as goety:necro_crown.
Storage for foci comes early because you will have dozens: goety:focus_bag, then goety:focus_pack. Guide: 'if you craft the focus pack, you'll have space for 20'.
gates: SOULS are the mod's currency and the hardest gate. Almost every ritual and brazier recipe in the jar carries a soulCost, and goety:dark_ingot alone costs 2000 souls at a brazier. Guide: 'you'll need a ton of energy and kill many mobs to start crafting with the totem of souls.' Collect them with goety:soul_absorber / goety:totem_of_souls into goety:soul_jar.
goety:dark_altar + pedestals gate EVERY ritual. Guide is explicit: 'To perform rituals, it's essential to have altars and pedestals, got it? It's crucial - without them you can't do any rituals.'

goety:empty_focus gates every single spell focus. Guide: 'each focus has its crafting recipe, but they all need the empty focus and rituals.' There are ~150 *_focus ids in the jar and all of them route through it.

Rituals are typed, and the type is its own gate. The jar defines 15 craftTypes - magic, necroturgy, forge, animation, sabbath, geoturgy, storm, frost, sky, deep, end, divination, overgrown, adept_nether, expert_nether - and a ritual will refuse until you can perform that type. Guide hits this live: 'it tells us this requires an animation ritual... you need the adept nether type of ritual and you need a hoglin inside the square.'

Rituals also gate on the ACTIVATION ITEM held, not just the ingredients: goety:dark_wand for necroturgy, goety:empty_focus for magic/sky/animation, goety:cursed_infuser for forge, goety:soul_emerald for the crown, a netherite ingot for the apostle summon.

Some rituals gate on world state, not items. Guide: 'some rituals need their own ecosystem requirements and a specific mob besides the usual items', plus a physical build area ('a square of 17x, you need to place 15 rails').
goety:cursed_cage needs 8 of the infused metal bars - guide: 'this bar is useless unless you get eight of them, which lets you craft a cursed cage.'
mechanics: Goety is a WAND + FOCUS system, not a spellbook system. goety:dark_wand is the single casting item; the ~150 foci (goety:fireball_focus, goety:blink_focus, goety:soul_bolt_focus, goety:meteor_shower_focus ...) are the spells, swapped in and out. Quests should chase foci, not wands.

Souls are spent, stored and transferred: goety:soul_jar and its variants, goety:soul_absorber, goety:soul_transfer, goety:soul_mender. Braziers (goety:stone_brazier, goety:blackstone_brazier, goety:necro_brazier and the soul_brazier variants) are the soul-powered crafting stations.

Necromancy is the identity: summon and command undead servants via foci and rituals (goety:troop_focus, goety:call_focus, goety:command_focus), with goety:necro_staff / goety:necro_crown / goety:necro_brazier as the dedicated line.

There are parallel elemental staff+crown+robe sets rather than one ladder: goety:storm_staff/goety:storm_crown/goety:storm_robe, goety:frost_staff/goety:frost_crown/goety:frost_robe, goety:wind_staff/goety:wind_crown/goety:wind_robe, goety:nether_staff/goety:nether_crown/goety:nether_robe, goety:void_staff/goety:void_crown/goety:void_robe, goety:wild_staff/goety:wild_crown/goety:wild_robe, goety:geo_staff, goety:abyss_staff, goety:nameless_staff, goety:ominous_staff. Pick a school, do not grind them all.
Cores are the ritual sub-ingredient tier that unlocks focus families: goety:wind_core, goety:mystic_core, goety:hunger_core, goety:animation_core.

Structures and bosses carry the late game (the guide tours a tomb and a wind shrine), ending at the Apostle - goety:apostle_spawn_egg exists and the summon ritual needs a netherite ingot as activation item.
traps: goety:treasure_pouch is called out as bad. Guide: 'then we have this treasure pouch which gives us this useless loot.'
Do not quest every ritual. Guide, mid-demo: 'We could do another ritual, but it'd be repetitive, not worth it.' One ritual per craftType is the teaching unit.

Do not build a quest chain out of the ~150 *_focus ids - they are a menu, not a ladder. The same applies to the ~12 pedestal and ~14 brazier stone variants, which are cosmetic material swaps of one block.
Shielded mobs need an axe specifically - guide: 'You need to break their shields with an axe... to hit these mobs you'll need an axe.'
human_notes.pack_status: INSTALLED. goety-2.5.55.4.jar plus addons goety_cataclysm-1.20-1.8.2.jar, goety_spillage-1.20-1.4.8.jar and goetyhostility-1.4.4.jar are in the reference pack. All 1318 ids come from the live instance jar. Note the addon jars contribute 0 ids to the goety namespace - they register under their own namespaces.
